mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Reports that King thrust mains produced since 2024 slip into the cap and block groove with no interference fit, raising a spun-thrust risk; the poster says King technical support confirmed 2024 production mains are out of spec on free spread. Safety and warranty implications, still unanswered by King.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully: still no King or official reply, thread open and unresolved, most recent post still 3 June 2026 where the poster reports receiving in-spec NOS Clevite thrust bearings.

mentions.title: Got a set of King SI bearings with a defective bearing...awesome
mentions.snippet: A King SI main set shipped with one shell malformed in production, crushed and twisted enough that it would not pass over the crank journal. Single credible defect report.
